propositions: The plan-review gate exempts all bug tickets to a bare PASS without substantive review, producing no actionable findings.
FixedBench's 35-65% over-action result (proposing changes without establishing necessity) has no detection criterion in the plan-review gate.
A new advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that add a mechanism without motivating or reproducing the need, while accepting justified no-ops and well-motivated outcomes.
Bugs require a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of the DET floor plus the necessity probe, never blocking, instead of the current exemption.

The necessity criterion and bug-tier logic must integrate into the existing advisory-routing pattern (criteria_routing.json entry, registry.CANONICAL_LLM, rubric prompt) and reuse the probe_criteria restriction seam.
